de: Nazi Germany mounts a false flag attack on the Gleiwitz radio station, creating an excuse to attack Poland the following day, thus starting World War II in Europe.

t: J. Robert Oppenheimer和他的学生Hartland Snyder出版了"奥p…
te: J. Robert Oppenheimer and his student Hartland Snyder publish the Oppenheimer–Snyder model, proving for the first time …
dz: J. Robert Oppenheimer和他的学生Hartland Snyder出版了"奥ppenheimer-Snyder"模型,首次在当代物理学中证明了黑洞是如何发展的.

dz: 二战:德国和斯洛伐克入侵波兰,开始了二战欧洲阶段.
de: World War II: Germany and Slovakia invade Poland, beginning the European phase of World War II.

t: 前一天入侵波兰后,但泽自由城(现波兰格但斯克)被纳粹德国吞并.

dz: 二战:前一天入侵波兰后,但泽自由城(现波兰格但斯克)被纳粹德国吞并.

te: The United Kingdom and France begin a naval blockade of Germany that lasts until the end of the war. This also marks th…
dz: 二战:英国和法国开始对德国进行海军封锁,封锁持续到战争结束. 这也标志着大西洋战役的开始.
de: World War II: The United Kingdom and France begin a naval blockade of Germany that lasts until the end of the war. This also marks the beginning of the Battle of the Atlantic.

t: 法国,英国,新西兰和澳大利亚在入侵波兰后向德国宣战,形成盟军国家. 印度的总督也宣战了,但没有…
te: France, the United Kingdom, New Zealand and Australia declare war on Germany after the invasion of Poland, forming the …
dz: 二战:法国,英国,新西兰和澳大利亚在入侵波兰后向德国宣战,形成盟军国家. 印度的总督也宣战了,但没有征求各省立法机关的意见.
de: World War II: France, the United Kingdom, New Zealand and Australia declare war on Germany after the invasion of Poland, forming the Allied nations. The Viceroy of India also declares war, but without consulting the provincial legislatures.

de: World War II: The British Royal Air Force suffers its first fighter pilot casualty of the Second World War at the Battle of Barking Creek as a result of friendly fire.

t: 缅甸民族英雄U Ottama在绝食抗议英国殖民政府后死于狱中.

dz: 二战:加拿大向德国宣战获得王室同意.

te: The submarine HMS Oxley is mistakenly sunk by the submarine HMS Triton near Norway and becomes the Royal Navy's first l…
dz: 二战:潜艇"Oxley"号被挪威附近的"Triton"号潜艇误击沉,并成为英国皇家海军在战争中首次丢失潜艇.
de: World War II: The submarine HMS Oxley is mistakenly sunk by the submarine HMS Triton near Norway and becomes the Royal Navy's first loss of a submarine in the war.

dz: 二战:爱沙尼亚军舰在塔林的波兰潜艇ORP Orzew(英语:ORP Orzelw (Tallin))上登上,引发了苏联日后会用来为吞并爱沙尼亚辩解的外交事件.
de: World War II: The Estonian military boards the Polish submarine ORP Orzeł in Tallinn, sparking a diplomatic incident that the Soviet Union will later use to justify the annexation of Estonia.

dz: 二战:德国潜艇U-29击沉了英国航空母舰"勇者号"(HMS Curageous).

dz: 二战:苏联入侵波兰开始.

de: World War II: The German submarine U-47 sinks the British battleship HMS Royal Oak within her harbour at Scapa Flow, Scotland.

dz: 文洛事件:两名英国SIS特工被德军俘虏.

t: 芬兰作家F. E. Sillanp被授予诺贝尔文学奖.

t: 9名捷克学生被处决,作为对扬·奥普莱塔尔逝世所引发的反纳粹示威的回应. 所有捷克大学被关闭,有…
te: Nine Czech students are executed as a response to anti-Nazi demonstrations prompted by the death of Jan Opletal. All Cz…
dz: 9名捷克学生被处决,作为对扬·奥普莱塔尔逝世所引发的反纳粹示威的回应. 所有捷克大学被关闭,有1200多名学生被送往集中营. 自从这次活动以来,国际学生会 许多国家,特别是捷克共和国都庆祝这一天.
de: Nine Czech students are executed as a response to anti-Nazi demonstrations prompted by the death of Jan Opletal. All Czech universities are shut down and more than 1,200 students sent to concentration camps. Since this event, International Students' Day is celebrated in many countries, especially in the Czech Republic.

t: 拉瓦尔平迪号(HMS Rawalpindi)被德军战列舰沙恩霍斯特号和格奈森瑙号击沉.

dz: 苏联在泰里乔基建立了芬兰民主共和国傀儡国家.

de: World War II: A day after the beginning of the Winter War in Finland, the Cajander III Cabinet resigns and is replaced by the Ryti I Cabinet, while the Finnish Parliament move from Helsinki to Kauhajoki to escape the Soviet airstrikes.

de: World War II: HMS Nelson is struck by a mine (laid by U-31) off the Scottish coast and is laid up for repairs until August 1940.
